role: XCTest suite for WorkoutAnalysisSnapshotBuilder.build: absences for empty input, α1 mean/min/max with beat-artifact dips excluded, 5 s sample cap across dropouts, band edges, the sustained AT1 crossing detector (warm-up, 180 s sustain, reset), HR zone bucketing, splits, moving-time signals, and robustness to bad offsets/zero duration/long workouts.

units.does: Fixture: a WorkoutSample at offsetSec with optional HR, α1, pace, cadence, METs, distance (altitude nil, power default nil).
Fixture: builder Inputs for a run with duration 1800 s, 5 km, max HR 190, meanHR 150, 75 kg, TRIMP 80 unless overridden.
Fixture: a 1 km Split with the given pace as duration and average pace, HR 150.
Asserts empty samples yield nil α1 mean/min/max, nil band seconds, nil zones/dominant zone/band and nil first crossing.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
